يرتجون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَجُونَ (yartajūna) /jar.ta.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# يُرْتَجَوْنَ (yurtajawna) /jur.ta.d͡ʒaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
